info.description: REST API of the PipeForge server. Every error response is an ErrorInfo object with a registered error code; texts follow Accept-Language (en-US, zh-CN).
info.title: PipeForge API

tags.description: The master and the workers of the cluster
tags.name: cluster

tags.description: Runs of jobs on the cluster
tags.name: runs

get.description: The master and every registered worker with its slots, labels, resources and last heartbeat, and how many slots runs hold. HTTP 503 without a master or when it cannot be reached.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: Master 以及每个已注册的 Worker：Slot、标签、资源和最近一次心跳，以及运行占用的 Slot 数。没有 Master 或无法连接 Master 时返回 HTTP 503。

post.description: Asks the leading master to give its lease up: a standby master takes over within a third of master.leader.lease, the runs go on there from their last checkpoints, and the old leader stops so that its supervisor starts it again as a standby. HTTP 409 when the masters elect no leader (no metastore), 503 without a master or when it cannot be reached.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 请主 Master 交出租约：备 Master 在 master.leader.lease 的三分之一内接管，运行从最近的 checkpoint 在那里继续，旧的主 Master 退出，由它的进程管理器重新启动为备 Master。Master 不选主（没有元数据库）时返回 HTTP 409，没有 Master 或无法连接时返回 503。

post.description: Gives a worker no new tasks: its free slots are offered to no run, and the tasks running on it finish where they are. The workers of the cluster show it as draining until it is uncordoned or a new master leads. HTTP 404 for a worker the master does not know.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 不再向 Worker 分配新的 Task：它的空闲 Slot 不再提供给任何运行，正在它上面运行的 Task 在原地运行到结束。在恢复调度或者换了主 Master 之前，集群的 Worker 列表把它显示为下线中。Master 不知道该 Worker 时返回 HTTP 404。

post.description: Gives a drained worker new tasks again. HTTP 404 for a worker the master does not know.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 重新向已下线的 Worker 分配新的 Task。Master 不知道该 Worker 时返回 HTTP 404。

get.description: The options of a source, transform or sink: types, defaults, requirements and the rules between them.

parameters.description: Plugin id or id@version; required when several plugins provide it
parameters.name: plugin

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: Source、Transform 或 Sink 的选项：类型、默认值、是否必填以及选项之间的规则。

get.description: Every registered error code with its message and hint templates.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 每个已登记的错误码及其消息和提示模板。

post.description: The logical plan of the job: settings, variables, nodes, options with their origin, schemas and warnings. An invalid job is an error response.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 作业的逻辑计划：设置、变量、节点、选项及其来源、Schema 和警告。作业不合法时返回错误响应。

post.description: Type-checks the expression against the given columns and evaluates it on their values. Mistakes are PF-PLAN-0007, failures while evaluating PF-DATA-0006.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 按给定的列检查表达式的类型，并用这些列的取值求值。表达式有误时返回 PF-PLAN-0007，求值失败时返回 PF-DATA-0006。

get.description: Every built-in function with its signatures, NULL behavior and examples.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 每个内置函数的签名、NULL 行为和示例。

post.description: Runs the job in the server up to a node, or up to its sink for a dry run, with the sinks replaced by a buffer, at parallelism 1, and returns the first rows of every table there. It stops at the row limit, at the end of the input or at the timeout; nothing is written to any target.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 在服务端运行作业，直到某个节点（试运行时直到 Sink），Sink 被替换为缓冲区，并行度为 1，返回该处每张表的前几行。达到行数上限、输入读完或超时时停止；不会写入任何目标端。

get.description: The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of job definitions, with the options of every installed source, transform and sink, for completion in editors. Validation stays with validateJob.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 作业定义的 JSON Schema（draft 2020-12），包含每个已安装的 Source、Transform 和 Sink 的选项，供编辑器补全使用。校验仍以 validateJob 为准。

post.description: Parses the definition, resolves its variables, checks the plugins, options, graph and schemas. Problems are part of the result, not an error response.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 解析定义、解析变量，并检查插件、选项、图和 Schema。问题作为结果的一部分返回，而不是错误响应。

get.description: Every usable plugin with its components, and the packages that were rejected.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 每个可用插件及其组件，以及被拒绝加载的插件包。

get.description: Runs newest first, optionally of some states or of one job. A page ends with the token of the next one in next.

parameters.description: States to list; every state when none
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: The token of a page, from next
parameters.name: page

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 按提交时间从新到旧列出运行，可以只看某些状态或某个作业。每页的 next 是下一页的令牌。

post.description: Plans the job, records a run and submits it to the master. An invalid job is an error response and no run is recorded. The run starts in QUEUE; GET /api/v1/runs/{id} follows it.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 计划作业、记录一次运行并提交给 Master。作业不合法时返回错误响应，不记录运行。运行从 QUEUE 开始；用 GET /api/v1/runs/{id} 跟踪它。

get.description: The run with its job definition and every change of its state, oldest first.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 运行及其作业定义，以及按时间顺序排列的每一次状态变化。

get.description: What limited the run and where (design 29): job-level figures, node-level figures and the bottleneck. Kept when the run ends.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: Get the analysis of a run

x-zh-CN.description: 运行受什么限制、限制在哪里：作业级与节点级的数字以及瓶颈结论。运行结束时保留。

post.description: Asks the master to cancel a run that has not ended; the run moves to CANCELLING, then CANCELLED. An ended run is returned as it is.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 请 Master 取消一个尚未结束的运行；运行先进入 CANCELLING，然后是 CANCELLED。已结束的运行原样返回。

get.description: A part of a task's log, through the master from the worker it ran on. offset in the answer is where the next read continues, so following a log means reading again from it; eof is true once the log was read to its end and the task has ended.

parameters.description: The vertex of the task, as in the tasks of the run
parameters.name: vertex

parameters.description: Where to start; negative counts back from the end
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Only entries of this level or above: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR
parameters.name: level

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: Read the log of a task

x-zh-CN.description: 经 Master 从 Task 所在的 Worker 读取一段日志。返回的 offset 是下一次读取继续的位置，跟踪日志就是从它再次读取；日志读完且 Task 已结束时 eof 为 true。

get.description: Rows, rates, waits, memory, splits and the counters of every node: from the master while the run runs, else the last sample the server kept (design 15).

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: Get the metrics of a run

x-zh-CN.description: 行数、速率、等待时间、内存、分片以及每个节点的计数：运行中时来自 Master，否则为服务端保留的最后一次采样。

get.description: The samples the server kept while the run ran (pipeforge.master.metrics-interval), oldest first; rates follow from two samples.

parameters.description: Only samples from this time on
parameters.name: since

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: Get the metrics of a run over time

x-zh-CN.description: 运行期间服务端保留的采样（pipeforge.master.metrics-interval），按时间顺序；速率由相邻两次采样得出。

post.description: Starts the next attempt of a run that failed, timed out or was cancelled, whatever env.retry allows: from its last completed checkpoint or from the beginning, with the same variables and plugin versions. The run moves back to QUEUE; its attempts are listed by GET /api/v1/runs/{id}.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: 为失败、超时或被取消的运行开始下一次尝试，不受 env.retry 限制：从最近完成的 checkpoint 或从头开始，变量和插件版本不变。运行回到 QUEUE；GET /api/v1/runs/{id} 列出它的各次尝试。

get.description: Every split the source assigned, with its reader and whether the reader finished; empty once the master no longer has the run.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: List the splits of a run

x-zh-CN.description: Source 分配的每个分片、读取它的读取器以及读取器是否已结束；Master 不再保留该运行后为空。

get.description: Every task with its state and worker, to read its log; empty once the master no longer has the run.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

get.summary: List the tasks of a run

x-zh-CN.description: 每个 Task 的状态和所在的 Worker，用于读取日志；Master 不再保留该运行后为空。

get.description: The PipeForge version, the connector API version and the Java runtime.

422.description: The job, expression or plugin options are invalid

x-zh-CN.description: PipeForge 版本、连接器 API 版本和 Java 运行时。
